body: Alex Scott remains at AFC Bournemouth amid reports of intense interest from Chelsea and Manchester City. Bournemouth's owner has publicly warned Scott about the transfer pressure while simultaneously expressing hope he signs a new deal, indicating the club is actively managing the situation rather than confirming a move.

findings.evidence_quote: Bournemouth owner admits Alex Scott could be lured by Chelsea or Manchester City
